LAHORE DEVEOPMENT AUTHORITY PRIVATE
LAHORE DEVEOPMENT AUTHORITY PRIVATE
HOUSING SCHEMES RULES, 2014
(Amendments)
[Gazette of Punjab Extraordinary,
26th October, 2017]
No. SO(H-II) 3-2/2016, dated 5.5.2017.---In exercise of the powers conferred under
section 44 of the Lahore Development Authority Act, 1975 (XXX of 1975),
Governor of the Punjab is pleased to direct that in the Lahore Development
Authority Private Housing Schemes Rules 2014, the following amendments shall be
made:
In the said Rules:
(9) In rule
3, after clause (d), the following explanation shall be inserted:
"Explanation.---The sponsor may develop a housing scheme, if it
consists of combination of different types of housing schemes, for an area not
less than 100 Kanal.".
(10) In rule
4:
(a) for
sub-rule (1), the following shall be substituted:
"(1) A sponsor shall not initiate:
(a) any
planning activity in the area, except housing scheme of the land sub -division
having an area less than 40 kanal, without obtaining preliminary planning
permission from the Authority; and
(b) any
development activity without obtaining approval of the plan from the Authority.
Explanation.---Notwithstanding anything contained in clause (a), the requirements of
documents and evaluation mentioned in sub-rule (2) of rule 4 and sub-rule (2)
of rule 5 shall, with necessary changes, apply to the land sub-division having
an area less than 40 kanal."; and
(b) in
sub-rule (2):
(i) for
clauses (f), (g) and (h), the following shall be substituted:
"(f)
(i) self-owned;
or
(ii) private
land not owned by the sponsor;
(g) the financial statement of the sponsor, if the
land is not owned by him, including:
(i) bank
statement; or
(ii) details
of self-owned assets;
(h) the financial statement of the sponsor showing
that funds are available or secured to purchase the proposed private land; if
the land is not owned by him;"; and
(ii) for
clause (k), the following shall be substituted:
"(k) receipt of the deposit of scrutiny fee
for preliminary planning permission.".
(11) In rule
5, in sub-rule (2), in clause (b):
(a) for
sub-clause (i), the following shall be substituted:
"(i) the
land is locked owing to the following:
a) surrounded
by an existing built-up area or any housing scheme; or
b) separated
from the vacant area by physical barriers such as proposed structure plan road,
main road, railway line, canal, distributary, or any other public project, farm
houses, graveyard or compound wall; or
c) surrounded
by the pockets of land which, if combined, do not form a housing scheme of area
having 100 kanal and above; and"; and
(b) after
sub-clause (ii), the following Explanation shall be inserted:
"Explanation.---Notwithstanding anything contained in sub-clause
(i), the Director General may on the recommendation of the committee consisting
of Director Metropolitan Planning and Director Engineering, if the sponsor
fails to obtain the adjoining vacant and owing to reasons beyond his control,
accept or reject the request of the sponsor regarding the condition of the land
locked area.".
(12) In rule
8, in sub-rule (2), in clause (f), after the word "area", the
expressions "though, for the land sub-division, the topographic survey
shall be made up to the boundary of the land sub-division" shall be
inserted.
(13) In rule
10, in sub-rule (1):
